findings.what: Knockout and Swim have no pause or leave control during a match (no button, Escape does nothing), so the only way back to the lobby is to finish the match or use the browser Back, while the other five games all offer "Leave the match?".
findings.where: public/js/knockout.js and public/js/swim/swimMain.js have no pauseMenu/DSDialog (compare public/js/headsoccer.js:343 pauseMenu); knockout.html and swim.html have no leave button

findings.what: On a phone held upright Head Soccer squeezes the pitch into the top 40% of the screen with tiny players and leaves a big empty navy gap above the buttons that only says "Turn your phone sideways for a bigger pitch".

On a phone held upright 8 Ball Pool turns the whole table sideways, so the player names, the VS splash, "FREE GAME" and the aiming hints all have to be read with your head tilted, and wide empty bands sit above and below the table.
On the phone the "Waiting for players to join" banner sits on top of the speed readout, so "Leave" is drawn over "0 km/h", the gear "N" and "on the start line" and is hard to see or tap.
The Swim Race "Leave" button is a 65 x 26 px text button, far under the 44 px touch size.
Head Soccer's pause button on an upright phone is drawn about 30 px wide with a 35 px tap area, smaller than the 44 px minimum.
findings.where: public/js/headsoccer.js:325-328 onPause (art.pauseAt r x VIEW.s x 1.15)

findings.what: Every game puts its leave button somewhere different with a different look: a green round pause top right (Head Soccer), a pixel "II" top left (Rooftop), a green hamburger top left (Pool), a small dark circle beside the rink (Air Hockey), a white "II" top right (Crossy), and none at all in Knockout and Swim.
findings.where: public/js/headsoccer/hsArt.js pauseAt; public/js/rooftop.js:210-233; public/js/pool8/p8Art.js:27 menu; public/js/airhockey.js:253-276 PAUSE; public/crossy.html #leave

findings.what: In Crossy Road, Escape does not open "Leave the match?" on PC, while Head Soccer, Rooftop, Pool and Air Hockey all do.
findings.where: public/js/crossy/crossyMain.js:144 keydown handler only handles the hop keys

findings.what: The leave dialog's main button is a gold gradient pill while every other game button (result card, queue card, lobby Play) is a bone or outlined button with 10 px corners, and gold is the site's money colour.
"Keep playing" in the leave dialog is a small text link 111 x 31 px, under the 44 px touch size.
The in-game chat uses Segoe UI and cold blue-black boxes with blue-white text, unlike the lobby and every other game overlay, which use Archivo on warm ink.
On phones the chat button is 40 x 40 px and the "Hide chat" button inside the open box is 24 x 24 px, both under 44 px.
The ping and FPS readout is set in the system monospace at 11 px instead of the lobby's IBM Plex Mono, so it is the one figure on screen in a different typeface.
On phones the ping/FPS readout sits on the bottom edge of the result card (6 px overlap), half hidden behind it.

Game chrome that does not: chat (Segoe UI 14 px, blue-black rgba(14,16,22) boxes), the ping/FPS box (system mono 11 px), the Leave dialog's gold pill button, Rooftop's flat coral rotate card (Archivo 800 white on coral).

Canvas HUDs follow each reference game and differ on purpose: Head Soccer (Heads Arena look, Sofia Sans Extra Condensed, Archivo heavy italics), Rooftop (pixel font, rtFont.js), 8 Ball Pool (glossy green/blue panels, Archivo 900), Air Hockey (neon cyan/magenta, Archivo), Crossy (blocky pixel numerals). Keep the art; unify what sits on top of it (leave control, names, chat, ping).

Leave control placement today: top right (Head Soccer, Crossy), top left (Rooftop, Pool), beside the rink (Air Hockey), none (Knockout, Swim). Own name: "You" (Knockout, Air Hockey) vs the guest name elsewhere.
Free result card: "Free" as the big figure everywhere except Swim (metres in red/green); facts "Score 1-3", "Your score / Theirs" (Crossy), "Balls potted" (Pool), "Turns" (Knockout).

Phone upright: Rooftop blocks, Head Soccer shrinks, Pool rotates sideways, the rest are portrait-native. Held sideways, Head Soccer, Rooftop, Knockout, Crossy and Pool look right; Air Hockey becomes a narrow column in the middle; Swim's speed readout lands on the car.
keep: One duel queue card in all seven games: same warm-ink card, same words ("Looking for a player… 0:09", "Free table. If nobody joins, you'll play a bot."), same 44 px Back to the lobby that returns to the game's lobby screen every time, PC and phone.
The free bot arrives after 10 s with the identical "Playing a bot" pill in every game (same style in every game CSS).

The shared result card (dsEnd): Lobby | Spectate | Play again in the same order in every game, 52-54 px buttons, low on the phone under the thumb, still fits a phone held sideways (384 px high); Lobby returns to the game screen, Play again re-queues, Spectate opens the watch view.

The shared Spectate bar: same Lobby chip, round previous/next and name plate in every game; an empty table shows the game's own empty pitch, rink, road or table (Knockout: blurred card art) instead of a blank page, with the arrows switched off.
"Leave the match?" now uses the same title, line and buttons in all five games that have it, and Leave goes straight back to the lobby.
Knockout's HUD is built from the lobby's own tokens (Archivo, IBM Plex Mono figures, warm ink, gold rim): the model for game chrome in the redo.

Swim's DOM HUD (names, gap rope, Plex Mono speed and gear) and phone controls (steer zone, big Gas and Brake pads, one-line hint); the crash result card appears with the wreck still visible behind it.
Head Soccer held sideways on a phone: full stadium, big touch buttons, clear score plate.
Air Hockey upright on a phone: rink fills the screen, score strip on top, pause and music buttons within reach (48-50 px tap areas).
No horizontal overflow, no low-contrast text, no console errors, exceptions or failed requests on any game screen at pc1440, phone or phone sideways.

Earlier sweep bugs re-checked and fixed: Pool's result card no longer throws, Pool's Escape opens Leave, Crossy's pause button hides on the result card, Rooftop draws "(bot)" under the sniper, Rooftop no longer stacks "Point" on "Wins!".
notReached: A real person-vs-person match: nobody else was queuing, so every match was against the free-table bot.

Real results for Head Soccer, Knockout, Rooftop, 8 Ball Pool and Air Hockey: matches last 2-4 minutes or many turns, so those cards were mocked by feeding a result into each page's own socket "over" listener during a live bot match. Swim (crash) and Crossy (eagle) results were real.

Swim Race live race HUD, real knocked-out card and real podium: no race was running (next one 5:00 PM ET, about 3 h 52 min away) and the owner's test race needs an owner session. The two cards were mocked with DSEnd.show using the page's own card shapes.
Swim's result card with the phone held sideways: no crash happened in that run and the mock cannot reach the page's private race state.
Watching a live Swim or Crossy match: our match had already ended (crash, eagle) when the watcher loaded, so those shots show the empty table.
Paid tables ($0.50 / $1) and their wait, refund and restake cards: not allowed in this audit.
The phone's own Back gesture as the way out of Knockout or Swim: not emulated by the probe.
Sending a chat message: not allowed; chat was only opened.
